title: GasFrees
tagline: A testnet chain that provides gas subsidy to WorldID verified humans

prizes.placement: Gas Subsidy with World ID & Reth
prizes.title: Gas Subsidy with World ID & Reth

description: This project aims to integrate WorldID verification before a transaction so that the transaction uses less gas on the chain. It is aimed to improve user experience for transactions over the chain for verified humans. The transactions are already expensive due to a lot of botting but it can be made cheaper for verified humans.
how_its_made: The project is built using the worldID verification over the cloud. There is a dashboard where you can verify yourself and then go into a transaction. Once the verification is done the transaction on the next page would use the locally running execution client OP-reth which would execute a subsidized transaction on the chain.
